title: Aspiring writer-director here. I’ve got a question.

commenti.body:
Ehrrr... Probably none. 

The first one is every single road movie I've ever watched, sort of like wannabe Little Miss Sunshine meets wannabe Rain Man. 

The second one sounds terribly pretentious, ESPECIALLY considering it would be a first attempt at filmmaking. I'd have doubts if Charlie Kaufman himself directed it, let alone some new upcoming director...

Lmao

I sincerely hope that the real story is a satire on a terminally online neckbeards who thinks he is an artist after watching a couple of A24 for movies.

In which case, your post captures that perfectly.

Neither but if you want advice as to which to shoot fiest, go for #1. It's a basic premise that can be easily and cheaply shot. A good way to learn the ropes and make rookie mistakes.

#2 is ambitious and I'd trust a veteran innovative director with a premise like that
